subject: ophthalmology
title: Bacterial Conjunctivitis and Ophthalmia Neonatorum

steps.tx: **Bacterial conjunctivitis** gives mucopurulent discharge matting lids, conjunctival injection and papillary reaction with preserved vision and minimal pain, usually self limited or antibiotic responsive. Purulence with morning crusting separates bacterial from viral watery and allergic itchy patterns at triage. Unilateral start becoming bilateral over days is typical contagion tempo in households and schools.
steps.say: Mucopurulent discharge gives bacterial pattern with preserved vision in conjunctivitis triage simply. Morning crusting gives separation from viral and allergic patterns. Contagion tempo gives household spread history.

vis.alt: Clinical photograph of an eye showing diffuse conjunctival injection and yellowish purulent discharge along the lower eyelid margin and eyelashes.
vis.caption: Acute bacterial conjunctivitis with diffuse conjunctival injection and purulent discharge. Image: Tanalai, CC BY 3.0.

steps.tx: **Ophthalmia neonatorum** is conjunctivitis in first month of life where timing separates causes: chemical in first days, gonococcal at two to five days with profuse pus and corneal danger, chlamydial at five to fourteen days with later pneumonia association. Any neonatal conjunctivitis needs Gram and culture sampling with systemic assessment, not drops alone. Prophylaxis at birth prevents gonococcal disease where prevalence justifies programmes.
steps.say: Timing gives cause separation in neonatal conjunctivitis during first month assessment critically. Gonococcal disease gives corneal danger needing systemic treatment. Sampling precedes drops alone always.

steps.tx: **Gonococcal conjunctivitis** in adults or neonates is hyperacute with copious pus, chemosis and corneal melt risk from sexually transmitted infection needing systemic therapy and partner pathways. Topical treatment alone fails because nasopharyngeal and genital reservoirs persist. Corneal ulceration may perforate within days, making this bacterial conjunctivitis an emergency exception to self limited teaching.
steps.say: Hyperacute copious pus together gives gonococcal emergency pattern with corneal melt risk urgently in adults and neonates. Systemic therapy gives reservoir treatment beyond topical drops alone. Partner pathway is part of eye care.

vis.alt: Ophthalmia neonatorum clinical findings with purulent neonatal conjunctivitis.
vis.caption: Neonatal purulent conjunctivitis. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Papillae versus follicles separates surface responses: papillae are vascular mounds in bacterial and allergic disease, follicles are lymphoid domes in viral and chlamydial disease, examined by everting lid. This single sign redirects microbiology expectations before swab results. **Eversion examination** is therefore mandatory in persistent conjunctivitis, not optional flourish.
steps.say: Vascular papillae and lymphoid follicles give response separation on lid eversion examination. Follicular pattern gives viral or chlamydial direction. Eversion is mandatory in persistence.

steps.tx: Discharge this profuse changes the tempo of everything that follows. **Hyperacute gonococcal conjunctivitis** swells the lids shut over a chemotic conjunctiva pouring out creamy pus, and the cornea can ulcerate and perforate within days. This is not a wait for culture situation: irrigate the pus away, treat systemically, and examine the cornea at every opportunity. Partner treatment and screening for other sexually transmitted infections complete the episode of care.
steps.say: Hyperacute gonococcal conjunctivitis pours creamy pus under swollen chemotic lids and can perforate the cornea quickly. Irrigate, treat systemically, and watch the cornea closely.

vis.alt: Clinical photograph style view of hyperacute gonococcal conjunctivitis, marked chemosis and lid oedema with profuse creamy purulent discharge.
vis.caption: Marked chemosis, eyelid oedema and profuse creamy purulent discharge are shown in hyperacute gonococcal conjunctivitis. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Chronic unilateral conjunctivitis refractory to drops needs structural differential: canaliculitis, dacryocystitis reflux, molluscum lid lesion, foreign body or masquerade malignancy in elderly. Sebaceous carcinoma masquerade returns here as conjunctivitis that never settles. **Refractory unilateral** is therefore biopsy and lacrimal pathway, not fourth antibiotic rotation.
steps.say: Refractory unilateral disease together gives structural differential beyond infection during assessment in clinic always. Lid lesion and drainage causes give examination direction for students. Biopsy pathway is a replacement for antibiotic rotation.

steps.tx: Contact lens wearers with conjunctivitis stop lenses until resolution and discard lenses and cases because biofilm reseeds infection, especially gram negative keratitis risk organisms. Pain, photophobia or reduced vision in lens wearer converts conjunctivitis label to keratitis emergency. **Red flags** pain, light sensitivity, vision change and corneal opacity override discharge pattern triage at every age.
steps.say: Lens cessation together gives biofilm control in wearer conjunctivitis management safely at every visit in clinic. Pain or vision change gives keratitis emergency conversion immediately. Red flags are above discharge triage always.

steps.tx: Membranous conjunctivitis stripping causing bleeding suggests diphtheria, ligneous or severe adenoviral disease needing microbiology and systemic review, distinct from pseudomembrane peeling cleanly. True membrane removal bleeds because it integrates with epithelium. **Bleeding on peel** is the bedside discriminator examinations ask directly.
steps.say: Bleeding on membrane peel gives true membrane disease direction needing systemic review urgently. Clean peeling gives pseudomembrane pattern instead. Bedside discrimination is direct here.

steps.tx: Anchors organise conjunctivitis triage completely: pus suggests bacterial, water suggests viral, itch suggests allergic, follicles suggest chlamydial or viral, and neonatal timing separates chemical, gonococcal and chlamydial causes by day. Hyperacute discharge means gonococcus, refractory unilateral disease means structure, and lens wearer pain means keratitis until disproved. **Vision preservation** is the conjunctivitis promise that must be verified at examination.
steps.say: Discharge pattern together gives triage while timing gives neonatal cause separation simply in clinic. Red flag verification gives safety beyond pattern labels at every visit. Lid eversion gives pattern completion in assessment.

cards.b: Chemical days one to two, gonococcal two to five with corneal danger, chlamydial five to fourteen with pneumonia link.
Papillae vascular (bacterial, allergic); follicles lymphoid (viral, chlamydial) on lid eversion.
Bleeds on peeling, unlike pseudomembrane; think diphtheria or severe disease with systemic review.

keys: Refractory unilateral disease is structural until disproved
Lens wearer pain is keratitis until disproved
